newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade light at $61 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade light at $61 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady.
Confirmed - 7,600 Last week - None Year Ago - 400
WK to date - 106,700 Last week - 78,700 Year Ago - 22,300
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 61.00. Carcass Basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 98.50.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 61.00-61.50. Carcass Basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 98.50.

Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 4,300 slaughter steers and 3,300 heifers; 106,700 head confirmed for week to date which includes 27,800 formulated and 100 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
